title: Nehemiah finds the genealogy of those who returned
description: After the wall is finished, God puts it on Nehemiah's heart to gather the nobles, officials, and people to register them by family lines. He finds the book containing the genealogy of those who first returned from exile with Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the other leaders. The list shows the number of men from the tribes and cities of Israel, priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, and Solomon's servants, as well as those who could not prove their Israelite ancestry and were therefore excluded from the priesthood. The chapter ends with figures for the entire assembly, their servants and animals, and the gifts of gold, silver, and priestly garments given for the work, before the people settled in their towns.
